_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN) row S-12-D (39a gap #8, the no-model half of S-12 held-secret chapters and threads). An inline two-chapter story (tavern, then the final road) in the toy group, knowledge tracking on, chapters seal/storySoFar/recap on with chronicleTokens 40, judge off. The same planted secret as S-11-D (a scripted Arin line, one mocked read with a plain fact, a paraphrasing fact and `[hiding] Arin from DM Narrator`), plus two open threads through applyExtractionAudit, one of which restates the secret. Each seal answer is storyOrchestratorDebugChapterSealResponse: SUMMARY, SHORT and a PEOPLE line carry the paraphrase beside plain sentences, no CONSEQUENCES (nothing to cite). The first seal is rt.chapters.sealNow(); the final one is the boundary seal after `/cp set step 1` (sealNow again if the boundary did not seal). Each stored record must hold the paraphrase verbatim (status sealed), so the readers are what hide it. Word rule mirrored in-page from memory/heldSecrets.ts + memory/words.ts as globalThis.__soS12, self-checked on the paraphrase. Surfaces asserted per sentence: /story chapters, /story chapter 1 and 2, /story chronicle, {{story_previously}} and {{story_so_far}} (resting and with the kept-out DM Narrator drafted), the Previously popup (rt.chapters.showPreviously), getNarrativeStatus, the rendered #so-player-overview after each seal, inline level 2 items and chips. Negative control: retire the [hiding] row and {{story_previously}}, /story chapter 1 and /story chapters must restate the paraphrase again. Not expressed: the captured seal / era-merge / saga / expansion / curator requests (off-path seams, jest secretShared.review.test.ts), the bridge note riding a generation (needs a real reply), a returning member's dossier, and the threads widget lanes (no selector known to this fixture).

requires.why: every model answer is a debug response; judge memoryVerify would drop the planted lines and judge the seal; player surfaces read in player mode, the one /cp (set step) runs through the slash verb's Author view wrap
